'''Nu Toreena''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. In [[130 ABY]], she was a member of the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]], the organization in charge of the Galactic Alliance government. Unlike her fellow Triumvir [[Gial Gahan]], Toreena was not a supporter of the [[New Jedi Order]], holding the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] responsible for the [[Sith–Imperial War]].

==Biography==
In [[130 ABY]], when the Galactic Alliance obtained intel about a meeting on the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] between [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and envoys of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Ascendancy]] and the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] about a possible alliance, Toreena supported the plans of [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]] [[Piers Petan]] of performing an attack with the goal of killing or capturing Emperor Fel. Even though the plan was rejected by Gahan, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]], all of whom suspected a trap, Toreena and Petan convinced the third Triumvir, [[Bail Antilles (Galactic Alliance)|Bail Antilles]] to go ahead with the strike.

As it turned out, the information was nothing more than an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] bait to lure the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] into a trap. In the resulting [[Battle of Caamas|battle]], the Galactic Alliance was defeated and then surrendered to the Empire, giving it the opportunity to occupy [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
